meta.task_name: Every button/control must be functional and tested

notes.note: DemoSpecArtifact defines minimalist_views, interactive_walkthrough, and core_flow_steps, but has no required per-screen inventory of controls/buttons nor their expected behaviors.
TestingStrategy is comprehensive, but does not explicitly require an interaction test matrix that covers “every control is functional (observable change) or explicitly disabled with explanation.”
Global and phase rules enforce minimalism + testing, but do not hard-require “no inert buttons” inventories and an interaction test matrix.

objective.summary: Modify spec-generation (schemas + prompts) so that every DemoSpec explicitly enumerates every interactive control per screen (with behavior, enable/disable rules, and loading states), and every CodeSpec mandates automated tests proving that each control either causes an observable UI/state change or is explicitly disabled with an explanation. Goal: zero inert buttons.

step.title: Schema: add per-screen interaction contracts to DemoSpec (required)

field.name: has_loading_state
field.description: Whether the control shows a loading/working state when activated.

field.name: loading_ui_behavior
field.description: What the UI does while loading (spinner/disabled/label change), and what ends the loading state. Use "not applicable" if has_loading_state is false.

field.name: enabled_when
field.description: Concrete conditions under which the control is enabled.

field.name: disabled_when
field.description: Concrete conditions under which the control is disabled.

field.name: disabled_explanation
field.description: What the UI shows/explains when disabled (tooltip/helper text/inline message).

field.name: control_id
field.description: Stable identifier for the control (used for mapping into tests and walkthrough targets).

field.name: label_or_icon_description
field.description: User-visible label, or icon description if icon-only.

field.name: control_type
field.description: Type of control (button, toggle, text input, select, slider, etc.).

field.name: expected_behavior
field.description: Exactly what happens when the user interacts with the control.

field.name: observable_state_or_ui_change
field.description: The observable change that proves it worked (state change, view navigation, new content rendered, toast/message, tool-call log entry, etc.). If the control is intentionally disabled in some states, this must describe what is observed when enabled.

field.name: enablement_rules
field.description: Enable/disable rules and disabled explanation.

field.name: loading_state
field.description: Loading/working UI behavior (or not applicable).

field.name: screen_name
field.description: Name of the screen/view this contract applies to. Must match one of DemoExperience.minimalist_views[*].name.

field.name: controls
field.description: Inventory of every interactive control on this screen.

field.name: notes
field.description: Any clarifying notes about interactions on this screen (or "none").

add_required_field.name: interaction_contracts
add_required_field.description: Required per-screen inventory of every button/control and its expected behavior, including enable/disable rules and loading states.

notes.note: Keep strict schema handling: model_config extra="forbid".
Contracts must cover every minimalist view; ensure the prompt enforces completeness (see Step 3).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Each screen contract lists every interactive control with behavior + observable change + enable/disable rules + loading UI.
screen_name is explicitly tied to MinimalistView.name to prevent drift.

step.title: Schema: require an interaction test matrix in CodeSpec.testing_strategy (required)

field.name: control_id_ref
field.description: Reference to DemoSpec interaction_contracts.controls[*].control_id.

field.name: when_enabled_expectation
field.description: What automated test asserts when the control is enabled (must include observable UI/state change).

field.name: when_disabled_expectation
field.description: What automated test asserts when the control is disabled (must include disabled explanation/affordance).

field.name: loading_state_expectation
field.description: What the test asserts about loading behavior (or "not applicable").

field.name: rule
field.description: Must include the rule: “Every button clicked triggers an observable state/UI change OR is explicitly disabled with explanation.”

field.name: matrix
field.description: Per-control test expectations mapped by control_id.

field.name: execution_notes
field.description: How these tests run deterministically (fixtures/mocks) and where they live.

add_required_field.name: interaction_test_matrix
add_required_field.description: Required interaction test matrix ensuring no inert controls. Must cover enabled behavior, disabled explanation behavior, and loading state behavior per control.

notes.note: Keep existing per-module plan fields; this adds an explicit “no inert buttons” contract that is machine-checkable.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: interaction_test_matrix.rule encodes the no-inert-buttons requirement verbatim (or near-verbatim) and matrix maps control_id_ref → expectations.

step.title: Prompts: enforce completeness and no-inert-buttons rule in phases 2 and 3

update_global_hard_rules.add_rule: No inert buttons: every interactive element must have defined behavior and automated test coverage.

update_phase_rules.add_rule: DemoSpec must include interaction_contracts covering every minimalist view and listing every button/control with: expected behavior, observable UI/state change, enable/disable rules with disabled explanation, and loading state behavior.
Interaction contracts must be complete (no “and other controls” language) and screen_name must match minimalist_views[*].name.

update_phase_priority_checklist.add_item: Include interaction_contracts for each minimalist view: enumerate every control with behavior + observable change + enable/disable + loading UI.
Ensure screen_name matches DemoExperience.minimalist_views[*].name and contracts cover all views (no omissions).

update_phase_rules.add_rule: TestingStrategy must include interaction_test_matrix where each DemoSpec control_id has deterministic automated tests proving: enabled → observable UI/state change; disabled → explicit disabled explanation; loading behavior validated when applicable.

update_phase_priority_checklist.add_item: Include TestingStrategy.interaction_test_matrix mapping every control_id_ref to enabled/disabled/loading expectations.
Matrix rule must state: “Every button clicked triggers an observable state/UI change OR is explicitly disabled with explanation.”

notes.note: Preserve “Return JSON only” and strict schema adherence.
Do not introduce extra plumbing; this is about interaction completeness and tests, not new features.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Phase-2 output reliably populates interaction_contracts completely.
Phase-3 output reliably includes interaction_test_matrix covering all controls by ID reference.

verify.item: After adding nested objects/lists to demo_spec and code_spec schemas, confirm openai_compatible_schema() still enforces additionalProperties:false, required includes all properties, and $ref-only nodes.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No regressions in strict structured output compatibility.

checks.check: Every generated DemoSpec includes complete per-screen interaction_contracts enumerating every control with behavior, observable change, enable/disable rules, and loading UI.
Every generated CodeSpec includes TestingStrategy.interaction_test_matrix mapping every control_id_ref to deterministic test expectations.
Prompt rules/checklists force completeness (no omissions, no vague “etc.”) and enforce the “no inert buttons” rule.
